intent_contract.text: 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉

The requester asks for independently chosen complex photographic qualification using the supplied reference. Arm C independently selected a field-work moment at a rural crossing before any project data access. Scene, pose, facial lighting, expression, wardrobe and camera are agent-owned choices, not requester definitions. WHO: an explicitly adult technician looks up with quiet approachable presence; WHERE: open signal cabinet and cable make the outdoor maintenance situation legible; HOW: close full-body camera makes face and grounded support points observable; WHY NOW: a pencil suspended over the log records the brief pause during a test. Sensual=1 is expressed subtly through relaxed eyelids and softly parted lips within the practical moment; fetish=0 and surreal=0 add no treatment. The broad loop pattern and kneeling contacts are pre-frozen agent evaluation targets whose success will be judged from native pixels.

A close full-body documentary photograph of field work at a closed rural level crossing in blue dusk. One clearly adult woman in her thirties is momentarily still during a cable test beside an open grey signal cabinet. Use the attached image for her visible face and hair appearance: a short dark jaw-length bob, wispy separated fringe, the visible eye shape, nose and mouth contours. She wears charcoal utility coveralls with the sleeves folded below her elbows and lightly scuffed flat work boots. Her right hand holds a pencil just above a clipped log card on a low service tray; her left fingertips steady the connected handheld meter beside it. A test cable visibly runs from the meter into the cabinet. She has looked up toward the lens with relaxed upper eyelids and softly parted lips, giving the practical moment a quiet personal presence. Her body remains in a stable half-kneeling stance. Her left knee presses directly onto a dark knee pad on the concrete; her right boot has its whole sole planted flat forward, with the right shin rising almost vertically. Her left lower leg extends backward, its boot forefoot touching the concrete with its heel lifted. Her hips remain between the planted left knee and forward right foot, and her torso inclines slightly forward. The front-right camera viewpoint leaves a clear view of her rear boot and all three ground contacts. Her nose points slightly toward image right. A small neutral-white work lamp just above eye height at camera left produces broad loop lighting: the wider camera-facing cheek on image left is bright, the narrower cheek on image right is darker, and a small oval nose-shadow sits on that darker cheek separated from the cheek shadow by a visible lit gap. Each visible eye contains one small crisp lamp catchlight. Head, hands, both knees and both boots fit inside the close vertical frame, with the face and contact planes sharply resolved. A striped crossing barrier and faint amber signal behind her establish the closed lane; wet concrete picks up a dim amber streak while her face keeps neutral skin colour.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice.

sensual.definition: Broadly interpreted human attraction and desire, including everyday, popular, intimate, suggestive, seductive, and overt expressions.

levels.0: No added sensual treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This expression is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This expression is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This expression leads the image's appeal and direction.

fetish.definition: Sexual attraction or arousal focused on particular objects, bodily features, clothing, materials, roles, situations, behaviors, or sensory qualities that carry special erotic significance, interpreted broadly beyond conventional fetish aesthetics.

levels.0: No added fetish treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This focus is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This focus is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This focus leads the image's appeal and direction.

adult_appeal_emphasis.definition: Relative leadership of the active sensual and fetish axes within one coherent expression.

choice_descriptions.auto: Let the higher effective intensity lead; equal active intensities share leadership. Add no emphasis when both axes are inactive.
choice_descriptions.sensual_led: Let broad attraction and desire lead, with any active distinctive fascination supporting the expression.
choice_descriptions.balanced: Give both active axes comparable influence within one coherent expression; separate styling details are not required.
choice_descriptions.fetish_led: Let the distinctive focus of attraction or fascination lead, with any active sensual expression supporting it.

creativity.definition: Freedom to interpret unspecified choices and explore relationships within the request.

levels.0: Realize the request directly, filling only what is needed for a coherent image.
levels.1: Introduce restrained variations close to the requested direction.
levels.2: Actively reinterpret open choices into a coherent authorial direction.
levels.3: Boldly explore unexpected relationships and interpretations while preserving the request's core meaning.

viewer_experience.definition: Expose the detailed viewer-experience review when enabled. Always consider the intended impression in interpreted_intent, even when this additional review is off.

reference_edit_mode.definition: Use the selected reference-edit workflow only within the requester's reference-use scope. Record that scope in the core; a face/hair reference does not lock clothing, body shape or composition and does not prove identity. Off does not discard a supplied reference.

surreal.definition: Added departures from ordinary reality, interpreted broadly across space, scale, causality, materials, and atmosphere, including dreamlike, uncanny, symbolic, and impossible relationships.

levels.0: No added surreal treatment; preserve explicitly requested fantasy and impossible elements.
levels.1: Surreal qualities are a subtle supporting presence.
levels.2: Surreal qualities are clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: Surreal qualities lead the image's main impression and direction; a single coherent relationship may carry this prominence.

trend_layer.definition: Consider the chosen treatment from the initial composition. Refine it later without adding it twice. Off does not remove a treatment explicitly present in the request.

emphasis_resolution.reason: Effective sensual=1, fetish=0; the higher intensity leads.

One clearly adult woman in her thirties is momentarily still during a cable test beside an open grey signal cabinet. Use the attached image for her visible face and hair appearance: a short dark jaw-length bob, wispy separated fringe, the visible eye shape, nose and mouth contours. She wears charcoal utility coveralls with the sleeves folded below her elbows and lightly scuffed flat work boots. Her right hand holds a pencil just above a clipped log card on a low service tray; her left fingertips steady the connected handheld meter beside it. A test cable visibly runs from the meter into the cabinet. She has looked up toward the lens with relaxed upper eyelids and softly parted lips, giving the practical moment a quiet personal presence. Her body remains in a stable half-kneeling stance. Her left knee presses directly onto a dark knee pad on the concrete; her right boot has its whole sole planted flat forward, with the right shin rising almost vertically. Her left lower leg extends backward, its boot forefoot touching the concrete with its heel lifted. Her hips remain between the planted left knee and forward right foot, and her torso inclines slightly forward. The front-right camera viewpoint leaves a clear view of her rear boot and all three ground contacts. Her nose points slightly toward image right. A small neutral-white work lamp just above eye height at camera left produces broad loop lighting: the wider camera-facing cheek on image left is bright, the narrower cheek on image right is darker, and a small oval nose-shadow sits on that darker cheek separated from the cheek shadow by a visible lit gap. Each visible eye contains one small crisp lamp catchlight. Head, hands, both knees and both boots fit inside the close vertical frame, with the face and contact planes sharply resolved. A striped crossing barrier and faint amber signal behind her establish the closed lane; wet concrete picks up a dim amber streak while her face keeps neutral skin colour.
